# Issue #150: ci/write-badges.sh as it was before PR #151, building skopeo's
# credential argument as --creds "actor:token". Named .txt rather than .sh
# because every tracked *.sh has to be an executable, shellcheck-clean script;
# tests/test-no-credential-in-argv.sh reads it as text and must flag the array.

creds_args=()
if [ -n "${REGISTRY_ACTOR:-}" ] && [ -n "${REGISTRY_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  creds_args=(--creds "${REGISTRY_ACTOR}:${REGISTRY_TOKEN}")
fi

created="$(printf '%s' "$(inspect_json "$IMAGE_REF" "${creds_args[@]}")" | jq -r '.Created // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)"
